title: Megurine Luka — Cool Beauty〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: VIRTUAL SINGER Stage

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hello, everyone.
My name is Megurine Luka.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I hope you've been enjoying yourself so far.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe, that's good.
I'll be singing from my heart today.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Let's start with this song...
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hm? That sounds like Megurine Luka?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Where is it coming from, though...? Ah.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Looks like it's this shop.
They even have a poster of Luka on the window.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Wait, what does this shop even sell?
CDs...no wait. Musical instruments, I think?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I can't see what's inside because of the poster...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ah, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Going to work?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah. What about you?
Ichika's not with you today...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi has work, and I'm on my way to mine too!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, what were you looking around for just now? Did something happen?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Nothing... I heard Megurine Luka's voice from this shop.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hm? Oh, you're right!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What do they sell here?
They're not open yet, I guess?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Seems that way.
There are a lot of cafes and bars that feature live music along this street, after all.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Maybe I should tell...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? Tell who what?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: There's a Megurine Luka fan in this band I know whose dream is to perform together with the VIRTUAL SINGER one day.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: This band's set list will always have a cover song of one of the VIRTUAL SINGERS when they perform.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Anyway, they're mostly Megurine Luka's songs.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh! What songs do they cover?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hm, I think they were doing this the other day...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow, that's such a cool song!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: They are a band after all, so the songs they cover are usually rock songs like this.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: She also sings a lot of English songs, so you can hear her doing jazz sometimes, too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Right, Luka's English pronunciation is so good after all!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Sigh... I'm so envious...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
She's good-looking, cool, and fluent in English!
Don't you wish you could become like that, too?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I guess.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Thank you, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: The event isn't over yet!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We have plenty more exciting songs waiting in the wings, so I hope everyone can look forward to it!
